hotels.description: Embrace barefoot luxury like never before at this award-winning five-star hideaway, where powdery white sands meet impossibly bright turquoise waters. Arrive in style with included transfers and surrender to complete relaxation with your every need attended to. Savour unlimited a la carte dining across three onsite restaurants, serving an array of gourmet flavours with international and traditional Maldivian dishes. Let time melt away as you sip free-flow drinks, including curated selections from the resort’s wine cellar. Lose yourself in the magic of the Maldives with endless aquatic adventures, from paddleboarding over crystal-clear lagoons and snorkelling through vibrant coral gardens to kayaking across the Gaafu Alifu Atoll's sparkling sea. For the ultimate indulgence, let The Pullman Spa elevate your senses with world-class treatments, from aromatherapy massages to sea salt scrubs, all in a breathtaking overwater setting. As the sky blushes at dusk, retreat to Sol Rising Bar for tropical cocktails by the infinity pool or set sail on a sunset cruise into the horizon. Whether you're honeymooning in paradise or treating your family to a once-in-a-lifetime escape, Pullman Maldives Maamutaa promises an extraordinary experience.
